desc: The Hunter viewer (HunterViewer: the Hunters screen and character creation). Each ability is shown in turn for slot_s seconds, its move looped on the real model. `moves`: per Hunter and slot, the kit moves (HunterAnim.KMOVES / KMovesPair) played back to back, the same ids the kits play. A slot with no entry falls back to the weapon swing or shot (lmb), the class dodge (dash), a cast pose (rmb, e, r) or an idle with its glow (passive). --hunter-unlock-check fails on an id that no longer exists, so a kit rename shows up here.
turn_rate_desc: rad/s the turntable spins while nothing plays; it slows to a third during a move
